recipes.name: Baked Donuts
instructions: Lightly grease a donut pan and preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*.
Place a sieve over a large bowl, and sift in the flour and baking powder. Then add the sugar and salt, and mix well.
Then add the milk, butter, applesauce, and vanilla. Stir until combined, but try not to overmix.
Fill each donut well until ¾ full. Bake on the center rack for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the top is golden and a toothpick inserted into the donuts comes out clean.
Make the vanilla glaze by combining the powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla in a bowl**. If the glaze is too thick, add a small splash more milk. Add a few drops of optional food colouring if desired.
Prepare the cinnamon sugar coating by mixing the sugar and cinnamon together on a plate. In a separate shallow bowl, melt the butter.
Remove the donuts from the oven and let cool for 2 minutes before flipping the donuts onto a wire rack until they are cool enough to handle, but still warm.
Dip half of the donuts in the glaze. For a thicker coating, let the first coat dry completely and then dip the donut in the glaze again.
For the sugar-cinnamon donuts, quickly dip the remaining donuts in the melted butter, and then in the mixture of sugar and cinnamon.
Transfer the frosted donuts to a wire rack and add optional toppings (like sprinkles) while the glaze is still wet. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** This recipe makes enough for half of the donuts to have the glazed topping, and half of the donuts to have the sugar-cinnamon topping.
Storage The donuts can be stored in an airtight container on the counter for up to 3 days.
